installCommand: if [ -f package.json ]; then npm install; elif [ -f el-favor-bitacora/package.json ]; then cd el-favor-bitacora && npm install; else echo 'No package.json found' && exit 1; fi
buildCommand: if [ -f package.json ]; then npm run build; elif [ -f el-favor-bitacora/package.json ]; then cd el-favor-bitacora && npm run build && cd .. && rm -rf dist && cp -r el-favor-bitacora/dist dist; else echo 'No build project found' && exit 1; fi
